steps.text: 1. When a Tourist views, starts listening to, finishes or downloads a public tour, the client sends an activity signal; the system counts each (tour, user, action, language, day) once and always returns 204. A2, E4.

exceptions.text: E4. A signal with no token and no device ID → 400.

steps.text: 2. The Contributor opens the tour in the Studio and chooses the "Statistics" step.
3. The system checks permissions and gets the figures for the last 30 days (default). E2.

exceptions.text: E2. The tour does not exist → 404; neither the author nor an Admin → 403.

steps.text: 4. The system shows the tiles: Views, Listens, Completions, Completion rate, Downloads; a daily chart and table. E1.

exceptions.text: E1. No data yet → "No statistics yet".

steps.text: 5. The system shows the ratings block: average score, count, distribution of 1–5 stars and the 20 newest comments.
6. The Contributor changes the period or the language. A1, E3.

exceptions.text: E3. A missing date or a start date after the end date → the client reports a filter error; the server returns 400 for an invalid filter; no network → an error message with a Retry button.

steps: A2. Signals that are not counted (tour not public, duplicate within the day, over 200 signals per day) still return 204.
A1. Filters: 7 / 30 / 90 days or custom (up to 366 days) and by language; the rating block is not filtered.
A3. The Admin can view the statistics of every tour.
